title: Trusting Allah Through Infertility
paragraphs: Setelah bertahun-tahun berusaha memiliki anak, Rania dan suaminya menghadapi masa depan yang belum dapat mereka lihat dengan jelas. Keadaan ini membawa duka, pilihan yang sulit, dan banyak percakapan sunyi. Rania tetap berdoa dan mencari dukungan yang tepat. Ia juga mengingatkan dirinya bahwa tawakal kepada Allah tidak berarti ia harus berpura-pura bahwa kehilangan itu mudah.

Beberapa bulan terasa sangat berat. Pada saat seperti itu, percakapan jujur dengan suami dan seorang konselor tepercaya membantunya menjalani kesedihan tanpa menghadapinya sendirian. Seiring waktu, Rania dan suaminya membangun kehidupan yang bermakna dengan lebih dari satu cara. Penerimaannya bertahap, tetapi memberi ruang bagi tujuan, kepedulian kepada orang lain, dan harapan kepada Allah.
answerKey: After years of trying to have a child, Rania and her husband faced a future they could not clearly predict. The situation brought grief, difficult choices, and many quiet conversations. Rania continued to make dua and seek appropriate support. She also reminded herself that trusting Allah did not require her to pretend that the loss felt easy. Some months were especially painful. At those times, honest conversations with her husband and a trusted counsellor helped her carry the sadness without facing it alone. Over time, Rania and her husband built a meaningful life in more than one way. Her acceptance was gradual, but it made room for purpose, care for others, and hope in Allah.
